Type.evidence_source: The interview schedule served as a guidance tool rather than a strict protocol in an attempt to produce richer data. Questions were all open-ended and anchored in the above areas of exploration. The schedule was piloted in two mock interviews, resulting in several refinements. Once the interviews were transcribed, each transcript was read and re-read for initial reflections, preliminary interpretations and emerging themes to allow the researcher to become more intimate with the data.
